title: Choose the new look for Rex Desk
question: Denser, smaller type, many things open at once. The roll assigned Line Map. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Line Map
options.lineage: Seoul Metro line maps and station signage
options.thesis: Every agent run is a metro line; you watch all of them move at once and step into any station.
options.viewport: Thin top bar; a live line map across the top where each run is a colored line through Queued, Working, Needs you, Verifying, Review and PR; below it a tiled grid of 2-4 open run panes beside a compact issue strip.
options.risk: Line colors can be mistaken for states; states must live on stations, never on line hue.

raised.raise: Data density: 12px body, 11px tabular numerals, no oversized headings anywhere.
1px hairlines are the only structure; no shadowed cards on the working surface.
Every line drawn at one fixed scale on a shared baseline, so progress compares at a glance.
Panes snap to whole grid cells; the workspace reflows by cells, never by squeezing.
One reserved color, amber, belongs only to the Needs-you station.

options.label: Strip Bay
options.thesis: Each issue is a strip you slide between bays; many flights in the air, one controller.
options.viewport: Graphite board of bays (Inbox, Analyzing, Working, Needs you, Review) packed with two-line strips; the right half splits into stacked live run panes.
options.risk: Familiar: underneath it is a Kanban board, and most runs in this category land near it.

options.label: Coupon Book
options.thesis: Each run is a coupon book; legs tear off, and outcomes stamp themselves: verified, used, void.
options.viewport: Runs as tabbed coupon columns side by side; each leg a ruled coupon with carbon-purple figures and a stamped state.
options.case: Fuses well with explicit outcomes (nothing disappears, it cancels); loses on audience identification.
options.risk: Tips into paper skeuomorph if stamps become decoration.

options.label: Datamatics
options.thesis: Runs as strobing black-and-white data columns.
options.case: Loses both: QA states need color, and the audience does not read barcode fields.

options.label: Design Annual
options.thesis: Runs as registered plates on uncoated stock.
options.case: Loses both: a gallery sheet is the opposite of dense multitasking.

options.label: Botanical Folio
options.thesis: A run's life as fixed-scale plates.
options.case: Loses both: lovely lifecycle, wrong audience and pace.
options.kept: One fixed scale and shared baseline across every run.

options.label: Grid Specimen
options.thesis: The workspace as a visible construction grid.
options.risk: Big letters, which you asked to lose.
options.case: Loses both: monumental type fights the density brief.
options.kept: Panes reflow by whole grid cells.

options.label: Orienteering Map
options.thesis: Each run as a purple course over fixed terrain.
options.risk: Terrain texture is noise on a work screen.
options.case: Loses both to Line Map, its closer and more familiar transit cousin.
options.kept: One color reserved for the active leg only.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A dense dev-tool workspace: dark sidebar, tabs, and split editor panes, executed cleanly.
canonCard.viewport: Sidebar of issues, tabbed runs in a 2x2 split, status bar at the bottom.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every editor-shaped tool by design.
